AI–Assisted App Build (II)

Week IIWeek I


app.R (copilot’s suggestion)





Initial fail (app cycling without presenting visual)

2 or 3 correction fails
not touched since last week (total time = ~20 minutes)


I would like to build a Quarto dashboard, powered by 
R, that has 3 primary functions. #1 - user types an 
address, #2 - a map displays the address, and #3 -data 
is shown about the address. I do have a US Census 
API Key if we go that route for the address data, but 
I am open to alternatives. Please provide all code 
necessary to execute this dashboard 


Out of several considered options, chose to build via GitHub Copilot  from within GitHub
